say:1:1510865001:1.text: Lady Merlin? How did you end up here?
say:1:1510865001:1.source_cn: 梅林女士？你怎么会来到这里？

say:2:1510865002:0.text: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...
say:2:1510865002:0.male: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...
say:2:1510865002:0.female: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...

choice_prompt:3:1510865002.text: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...
choice_prompt:3:1510865002.source_cn: 还有<style=stress><player_name></style>……呵，没想到，你根本不是狩猎神奥法迦，我被你骗得团团转。
choice_prompt:3:1510865002.male: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...
choice_prompt:3:1510865002.female: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you never were a deity. You tricked me completely...

say:4:1510865003:1.text: Save me? No need. The Hunting Goddess has promised to aid Halia during the famine.
say:4:1510865003:1.source_cn: 救？危机已经解除，狩猎神已经许诺要帮助呼临人度过饥荒。
say:4:1510865003:1.male: Save me? No need. The Hunting Goddess has promised to aid Halia during the famine.
say:4:1510865003:1.female: Save me? No need. The Hunting Goddess has promised to aid Halia during the famine.

say:6:1510865007:0.text: Perseus, has that wine completely dulled your judgment? How could the Hunting Goddess help the Halians? The Wildborn are already at war with your soldiers.
say:6:1510865007:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，那些美酒让你丧失了基本的判断力吗？狩猎神怎么...

say:9:1510865009:1.text: Compared to Gorgonna and the Hunting Goddess who are willing to extend a hand to Halia, are you asking me to trust you—the one who vanished halfway through the fight?!
say:9:1510865009:1.source_cn: 比起愿意向呼临人伸出援手的露和狩猎神，难道要让我选择相...
say:9:1510865009:1.male: Compared to Gorgonna and the Hunting Goddess who are willing to extend a hand to Halia, are you asking me to trust you—the one who vanished halfway through the fight?!
say:9:1510865009:1.female: Compared to Gorgonna and the Hunting Goddess who are willing to extend a hand to Halia, are you asking me to trust you—the one who vanished halfway through the fight?!

say:10:1510865010:1.text: If not for Gorgonna... if the Hunting Goddess hadn't intervened, I'd be dead by now.
say:10:1510865010:1.source_cn: 如果不是露求情，狩猎神宽悯，此刻的我已经是一具尸骨！

say:11:1510865011:0.text: Perseus... you once said that Gorgonna was dead.
say:11:1510865011:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，你曾说过，露已经死了。

say:12:1510865012:0.text: No. Her soul returned to the shrine after the ritual. She has been serving Azora here ever since.
say:12:1510865012:0.source_cn: 不，露告诉我，她的灵魂在祭祀仪式后重回神殿，她一直在这...

say:14:1510865013:0.text: Azora treated her well, and she promised to bring Gorgonna's loved one back to see her...
say:14:1510865013:0.source_cn: 奥法迦对她很好，于是答应她，将她最想见的人带到她身边……

say:15:1510865014:1.text: She told Azora about my worries... the famine, the war. And she made sure Gorgonna delivered a message: <style="highlight">that she wouldn't send troops to Halia, and was even willing to help us through the crisis</style>.
say:15:1510865014:1.source_cn: 她从露口中得知我一直为饥荒和战争担忧，特意让露转告我，...

say:16:1510865015:1.text: So I made a promise. I told Gorgonna I'd stay here with her. I don't want to leave her again.
say:16:1510865015:1.source_cn: 所以，我答应露留在这里陪她。我不想再和她分开了。

choice_prompt:17:1510865015.text: So I made a promise. I told Gorgonna I'd stay here with her. I don't want to leave her again.
choice_prompt:17:1510865015.source_cn: 所以，我答应露留在这里陪她。我不想再和她分开了。

say:18:1510865016:1.text: No. You're the liar here... False god.
say:18:1510865016:1.male: No. You're the liar here... False god.
say:18:1510865016:1.female: No. You're the liar here... False goddess.

narration:20:1510865018:1.text: Merlin pulls you aside, her face unreadable.
narration:20:1510865018:1.male: Merlin pulls you aside, her face unreadable.
narration:20:1510865018:1.female: Merlin pulls you aside, her face unreadable.

say:22:1510865019:0.text: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.
say:22:1510865019:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯不是如此轻信之人……魔法对他的迷惑作用不容小觑...
say:22:1510865019:0.male: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.
say:22:1510865019:0.female: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.

choice_prompt:23:1510865019.text: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.
choice_prompt:23:1510865019.source_cn: 珀尔修斯不是如此轻信之人……魔法对他的迷惑作用不容小觑。我怀疑那些酒或许也有问题。
choice_prompt:23:1510865019.male: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.
choice_prompt:23:1510865019.female: This isn't like Perseus. He doesn't fall for lies so easily. The magic's influence on him can't be underestimated. I'm convinced it's more than him just being tipsy—there's a deeper spell at work.

choice:23:0:1.text: We need to come up with a plan.
choice:23:0:1.male: We need to come up with a plan.
choice:23:0:1.female: We need to come up with a plan.

say:27:1510865021:0.text: Don't be too harsh on him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's not a fool. Just... lost right now.
say:27:1510865021:0.male: Don't be too harsh on him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's not a fool. Just... lost right now.
say:27:1510865021:0.female: Don't be too harsh on him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's not a fool. Just... lost right now.

say:28:1510865022:0.text: Being tipsy has definitely allowed the spell to sink its claws in more easily. It won't be easy to snap him out of it.
say:28:1510865022:0.source_cn: 他喝了太多不该喝的东西，深陷迷惑魔法，没那么容易清醒过来。
say:28:1510865022:0.male: Being tipsy has definitely allowed the spell to sink its claws in more easily. It won't be easy to snap him out of it.
say:28:1510865022:0.female: Being tipsy has definitely allowed the spell to sink its claws in more easily. It won't be easy to snap him out of it.

choice:23:1:2.text: It's not the wine. His mind's the problem.
choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 不怪那些酒，他脑子有问题
choice:23:1:2.male: It's not the wine. His mind's the problem.
choice:23:1:2.female: It's not the wine. His mind's the problem.

choice:17:1:2.text: The Hunting Goddess broke her word.
choice:17:1:2.male: The Hunting Goddess broke her word.
choice:17:1:2.female: The Hunting Goddess broke her word.

choice:3:0:1.text: Be nice. I'm here to save you.
choice:3:0:1.male: Be nice. I'm here to save you.
choice:3:0:1.female: Be nice. I'm here to save you.

say:29:1510865004:1.text: I gave my word to Gorgonna. I'll stay by her side. Besides, the goddess she follows has already promised to help Halia through the famine.
say:29:1510865004:1.source_cn: 我答应了露，要在这里陪她。更何况狩猎神已经许诺要帮助呼...
say:29:1510865004:1.male: I gave my word to Gorgonna. I'll stay by her side. Besides, the goddess she follows has already promised to help Halia through the famine.
say:29:1510865004:1.female: I gave my word to Gorgonna. I'll stay by her side. Besides, the goddess she follows has already promised to help Halia through the famine.

choice:3:1:2.text: There's no time. Come with us now!
choice:3:1:2.male: There's no time. Come with us now!
choice:3:1:2.female: There's no time. Come with us now!

say:31:1510865006:1.text: You mean... the promise? Her aid to the Halians?
say:31:1510865006:1.source_cn: 难道你们指的是她许诺帮呼临人度过饥荒的事？
say:31:1510865006:1.male: You mean... the promise? Her aid to the Halians?
say:31:1510865006:1.female: You mean... the promise? Her aid to the Halians?

choice:3:2:3.text: Open your eyes! You're being tricked!
choice:3:2:3.male: Open your eyes! You're being tricked!
